صَرَبَةٌ : see صَرْبٌ, in three places. ―
-b2- Also A herb, (M, K,) and tree, (M,) that becomes green, and puts forth leaves, when dry, or that has grown, or become somewhat restored to a good state, after having been eaten [or depastured], (يَتَجَبَّرُ, so in the M, [in the K يَتَخَيَّرُ, which, as is remarked in the TK, is a mistake,]) after men [have fed their cattle therefrom]: pl. [or rather coll. gen. n.] ↓ صَرَبٌ . (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
